settings.connections.title: In the cloud
settings.connections.description: Hermes, OpenClaw, ChatGPT, Claude or another orchestrator can create and follow tasks on your machines. Each one only sees its own tasks, uses the permission mode you give it, and approvals come to you.
settings.connections.failed: That did not work. Try again.
settings.connections.unavailable: Sign in with your Danil account
settings.connections.unavailable_hint: Connections live in your Danil account, in Danil Machines.
settings.connections.empty_hint: Paste {url} as an MCP server in your orchestrator and sign in with Danil. It will show up here so you can give it a machine and permissions.
settings.connections.pending_hint: Review the available access and activate the connection.
settings.connections.revoke_body: It stops being able to create or read tasks on your machines right away. What it already did stays in Danil.
settings.connections.no_machines: None of your machines has a workspace synced with your Danil account.
settings.connections.local.title: On this machine
settings.connections.local.description: An orchestrator running here (Claude Code, Hermes, OpenClaw) creates and follows tasks without a Danil account. It only sees its own tasks, and approvals come to you.
settings.connections.local.setup_hint: Paste one of these into your orchestrator. The credential is a private file on this machine; don't share it.
settings.connections.local.name: Name
settings.connections.local.disconnect_bo: Its credential stops working right away. What it already did stays in its tasks.
settings.connections.webhook.title: Webhook
settings.connections.webhook.none: No webhook: the orchestrator asks with inbox_take
settings.connections.webhook.invalid: Use a public https address (no localhost, IPs or a port other than 443).
settings.connections.webhook.hint: When a task of this orchestrator replies, Danil sends a signed notice to this address. The reply text does not travel.
settings.connections.webhook.secret_hint: Copy it now: it is not shown again. Use it to verify the X-Danil-Signature header.
settings.connections.mcp_hint: Tools your agents use in their tasks.
settings.connections.access_hint: Choose the workspaces this connection can use on each computer. New connections include all available options.
settings.connections.access_limit: The service supports up to {count} destinations per connection. Clear some before saving.
settings.connections.service_limit: This service version supports only one workspace per computer. Destinations already used keep their workspace.
settings.connections.one_workspace: Choose only one workspace per computer before activating.
settings.connections.access_saved: Selection saved. Access is checked when the orchestrator uses each destination.
settings.connections.approval_fixed: An existing connection keeps its approval mode. The service does not yet support changing it.
